ModMetaData.name: Sims Mode Community: Living Settlements
ModMetaData.author: GuanYu Lu
ModMetaData.description: Visit a non-hostile faction settlement and its people actually live: working by day, gathering in the evening, sleeping at night. Fully data-driven (faction profiles, roles, schedules, facility tags) so other mods can patch everything. Phase 1 of the Sims Mode Community project.
